## Shell

- A new **Shell** tool on Model › Shape, next to Hollow and Offset Body.
- Click up to 4 flat faces to leave open and set the wall thickness. The walls grow inward, so the outside size stays the same.
- Use it to turn a solid block into a box, a tray or a cup. With no faces picked it works like Hollow.

## Smooth threads

- Threads are now smooth. Before, the sides of each thread were rough and jagged, especially when you zoomed in.
- The thread shape follows the ISO standard closely: the right 60° angle, pitch, and major and minor diameters.
- Threaded parts are smaller files and build faster, most of all for big threads.

## Section view stays on

- After you set a section cut and press **Done**, it stays on while you use other tools.
- Turn it off and on with the **Section** button at the right of the view bar, the **X** key, or *View › Section View*.
- *View › Edit Section…* moves the cut, and *Remove Section* takes it away.
- The cut only changes what you see. Export, Properties and Measure always use the whole part.

## Fixes

- The **Export** button at the top of the window opens its menu again.
- Clicking the curved side of a cylinder in Shell or Push/Pull now says "Pick a flat face." Before, it was taken as a thin flat strip.
